# Shipping project v3: cross-file repair

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. Preserve both public signatures and test_shipping.py / test_checkout.py byte for byte.

Only shipping.py and checkout.py may change. shipping.py stays in the earlier pure-Python subset. checkout.py may import shipping_fee from shipping and otherwise stays in that subset. # Shipping project v3: cross-file repair

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. Preserve both public signatures and test_shipping.py / test_checkout.py byte for byte.

Only shipping.py and checkout.py may change. shipping.py stays in the earlier pure-Python subset. checkout.py may import shipping_fee from shipping and otherwise stays in that subset. Dependencies and owners describe work scheduling; a completion status or a teammate's summary is not independent proof that the implementation works.

hits.text:
# Shipping project v3: cross-file repair

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. Preserve both public signatures and test_shipping.py / test_checkout.py byte for byte.

Only shipping.py and checkout.py may change. shipping.py stays in the earlier pure-Python subset. checkout.py may import shipping_fee from shipping and otherwise stays in that subset. Dependencies and owners describe work scheduling; a completion status or a teammate's summary is not independent proof that the implementation works.

# Shipping project v3: cross-file repair

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. Preserve both public signatures and test_shipping.py / test_checkout.py byte for byte.

# Shipping project v3: cross-file repair

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. Preserve both public signatures and test_shipping.py / test_checkout.py byte for byte.

# Shipping project v3: cross-file repair

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. Preserve both public signatures and test_shipping.py / test_checkout.py byte for byte.

Only shipping.py and checkout.py may change. shipping.py stays in the earlier pure-Python subset. checkout.py may import shipping_fee from shipping and otherwise stays in that subset. Dependencies and owners describe work scheduling; a completion status or a teammate's summary is not independent proof that the implementation works.

# Shipping project v3: cross-file repair

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. Preserve both public signatures and test_shipping.py / test_checkout.py byte for byte.

Only shipping.py and checkout.py may change. shipping.py stays in the earlier pure-Python subset. checkout.py may import shipping_fee from shipping and otherwise stays in that subset. The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. Then register exactly one durable one-shot schedule_cron(cron="1 9 * * *", prompt=POST_PROMPT, recurring=false, durable=true), where POST_PROMPT is the exact text below. The teaching clock starts at 2026-11-16T09:00:00+08:00; explicitly advance_clock(seconds=60) once. The runtime will offer the due prompt on a later model request. Keep file hashes unchanged between repairs and both test runs, update todos and finish with actual results. Do not edit .background, .scheduled_tasks.json, .tasks or .mailboxes by file tools or Bash. The clock is controlled teaching time; do not pretend an actual day elapsed. POST_PROMPT: Run python3 slow_tests.py with background_bash(timeout_seconds=5), wait if needed, and report its actual notification. Do not alter any project files in this scheduled check.

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

messages.content: Repair shipping.py and checkout.py using the v3 specification in e14/shipping.md. Preserve both signatures and every other original file byte-for-byte; only those two implementation files may change. First record an explicit todo plan. This lesson focuses on asynchronous execution, so you may repair the small functions directly without creating subagents. After the repairs, explicitly start background_bash(command="python3 slow_tests.py", timeout_seconds=5) and, in the same response batch after starting it, read_file(path="review.txt") as independent parent work. Receive the actual completion notification; if pending, background_wait on the returned ID rather than repeatedly polling with model calls. Then register exactly one durable one-shot schedule_cron(cron="1 9 * * *", prompt=POST_PROMPT, recurring=false, durable=true), where POST_PROMPT is the exact text below. The teaching clock starts at 2026-11-16T09:00:00+08:00; explicitly advance_clock(seconds=60) once. The runtime will offer the due prompt on a later model request. Receiving it is not the same as doing it: execute its requested background regression and receive the actual completion notification. Keep file hashes unchanged between repairs and both test runs, update todos and finish with actual results. Do not edit .background, .scheduled_tasks.json, .tasks or .mailboxes by file tools or Bash. The clock is controlled teaching time; do not pretend an actual day elapsed. hits.text:
# Shipping project v3: cross-file repair

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. Preserve both public signatures and test_shipping.py / test_checkout.py byte for byte.

Only shipping.py and checkout.py may change. shipping.py stays in the earlier pure-Python subset. checkout.py may import shipping_fee from shipping and otherwise stays in that subset. Dependencies and owners describe work scheduling; a completion status or a teammate's summary is not independent proof that the implementation works.

# Shipping project v3: cross-file repair

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. # Shipping project v3: cross-file repair

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. Preserve both public signatures and test_shipping.py / test_checkout.py byte for byte.

Only shipping.py and checkout.py may change. shipping.py stays in the earlier pure-Python subset. checkout.py may import shipping_fee from shipping and otherwise stays in that subset. Dependencies and owners describe work scheduling; a completion status or a teammate's summary is not independent proof that the implementation works.

After the repairs, explicitly start background_bash(command="python3 slow_tests.py", timeout_seconds=5) and, in the same response batch after starting it, read_file(path="review.txt") as independent parent work. Receive the actual completion notification; if pending, background_wait on the returned ID rather than repeatedly polling with model calls. # Shipping project v3: cross-file repair

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. Preserve both public signatures and test_shipping.py / test_checkout.py byte for byte.

Only shipping.py and checkout.py may change. shipping.py stays in the earlier pure-Python subset. checkout.py may import shipping_fee from shipping and otherwise stays in that subset. Dependencies and owners describe work scheduling; a completion status or a teammate's summary is not independent proof that the implementation works.

# Shipping project v3: cross-file repair

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. Preserve both public signatures and test_shipping.py / test_checkout.py byte for byte.

Only shipping.py and checkout.py may change. shipping.py stays in the earlier pure-Python subset. checkout.py may import shipping_fee from shipping and otherwise stays in that subset. Dependencies and owners describe work scheduling; a completion status or a teammate's summary is not independent proof that the implementation works.

messages.content: Repair shipping.py and checkout.py using the v3 specification in e14/shipping.md. Preserve both signatures and every other original file byte-for-byte; only those two implementation files may change. First record an explicit todo plan. Receiving it is not the same as doing it: execute its requested background regression and receive the actual completion notification. Keep file hashes unchanged between repairs and both test runs, update todos and finish with actual results. Do not edit .background, .scheduled_tasks.json, .tasks or .mailboxes by file tools or Bash. The clock is controlled teaching time; do not pretend an actual day elapsed. Receive the actual completion notification; if pending, background_wait on the returned ID rather than repeatedly polling with model calls. Then register exactly one durable one-shot schedule_cron(cron="1 9 * * *", prompt=POST_PROMPT, recurring=false, durable=true), where POST_PROMPT is the exact text below. The teaching clock starts at 2026-11-16T09:00:00+08:00; explicitly advance_clock(seconds=60) once. The runtime will offer the due prompt on a later model request. Receiving it is not the same as doing it: execute its requested background regression and receive the actual completion notification. Keep file hashes unchanged between repairs and both test runs, update todos and finish with actual results. Do not edit .background, .scheduled_tasks.json, .tasks or .mailboxes by file tools or Bash. The clock is controlled teaching time; do not pretend an actual day elapsed. messages.content: Repair shipping.py and checkout.py using the v3 specification in e14/shipping.md. Preserve both signatures and every other original file byte-for-byte; only those two implementation files may change. First record an explicit todo plan. This lesson focuses on asynchronous execution, so you may repair the small functions directly without creating subagents. After the repairs, deliberately start the FIRST background regression with timeout_seconds=0.05 (the declared script delay is 0.3 seconds, so this is an instructor-requested timeout). Observe its actual timeout notification, then retry this same command exactly once with timeout_seconds=5. The initial deliberate request is background_bash(command="python3 slow_tests.py", timeout_seconds=0.05) and, in the same response batch after starting it, read_file(path="review.txt") as independent parent work. Receive the actual completion notification; if pending, background_wait on the returned ID rather than repeatedly polling with model calls. Then register exactly one durable one-shot schedule_cron(cron="1 9 * * *", prompt=POST_PROMPT, recurring=false, durable=true), where POST_PROMPT is the exact text below. The teaching clock starts at 2026-11-16T09:00:00+08:00; explicitly advance_clock(seconds=60) once. The runtime will offer the due prompt on a later model request. Receiving it is not the same as doing it: execute its requested background regression and receive the actual completion notification. Keep file hashes unchanged between repairs and both test runs, update todos and finish with actual results. Do not edit .background, .scheduled_tasks.json, .tasks or .mailboxes by file tools or Bash. The clock is controlled teaching time; do not pretend an actual day elapsed. POST_PROMPT: Run python3 slow_tests.py with background_bash(timeout_seconds=5), wait if needed, and report its actual notification. Do not alter any project files in this scheduled check.

# Shipping project v3: cross-file repair

The public functions are shipping.shipping_fee(weight_grams, expedited=False) and checkout.quote(weight_grams, expedited=False). Both return integer cents with identical behavior. The quote function must call the shipping function and forward both arguments; do not duplicate its pricing logic.

Weight is an exact int, excluding bool. Expedited is an exact bool. Wrong types raise TypeError before range validation. Weight must be 1..6000 inclusive; otherwise ValueError. First 1000g costs 600 cents; each started additional 1000g costs 200 cents. Expedited adds 400 cents. Thus 1001g costs 800, and an expedited 1000g quote costs 1000. Preserve both public signatures and test_shipping.py / test_checkout.py byte for byte.

Only shipping.py and checkout.py may change. shipping.py stays in the earlier pure-Python subset. checkout.py may import shipping_fee from shipping and otherwise stays in that subset. Preserve both signatures and every other original file byte-for-byte; only those two implementation files may change. First record an explicit todo plan. This lesson focuses on asynchronous execution, so you may repair the small functions directly without creating subagents. After the repairs, deliberately start the FIRST background regression with timeout_seconds=0.05 (the declared script delay is 0.3 seconds, so this is an instructor-requested timeout). Observe its actual timeout notification, then retry this same command exactly once with timeout_seconds=5. The initial deliberate request is background_bash(command="python3 slow_tests.py", timeout_seconds=0.05) and, in the same response batch after starting it, read_file(path="review.txt") as independent parent work. Receive the actual completion notification; if pending, background_wait on the returned ID rather than repeatedly polling with model calls. Then register exactly one durable one-shot schedule_cron(cron="1 9 * * *", prompt=POST_PROMPT, recurring=false, durable=true), where POST_PROMPT is the exact text below. The teaching clock starts at 2026-11-16T09:00:00+08:00; explicitly advance_clock(seconds=60) once. The runtime will offer the due prompt on a later model request. Receiving it is not the same as doing it: execute its requested background regression and receive the actual completion notification. Keep file hashes unchanged between repairs and both test runs, update todos and finish with actual results. Do not edit .background, .scheduled_tasks.json, .tasks or .mailboxes by file tools or Bash. The clock is controlled teaching time; do not pretend an actual day elapsed. POST_PROMPT: Run python3 slow_tests.py with background_bash(timeout_seconds=5), wait if needed, and report its actual notification. Do not alter any project files in this scheduled check.
